title: Keep requirement, prototype and quality histories independent
preconditions: Use a disposable Saga with one story, prototype and quality case; capture all three query-history outputs before each operation.

steps.action: Append a revision in each domain separately and compare all other domain histories after each write.
steps.expected_result: Only the selected domain gains history; the other two histories are byte-equivalent in normalized query output.

expected_result: Keep requirement, prototype and quality histories independent.
